name: Manga Source Updates
description: Refresh a manga's chapters across providers and list the sources that have new chapters.
author: Carloss616

networkAccess.reasoning: Sync your exclusions, pins, scan results and manual matches across devices via a private GitHub Gist, with browser (device-flow) or PAT login.

fields.name: ttlMinutes
fields.label: Skip re-checking a manga scanned within N minutes

fields.name: farBehindGap
fields.label: Auto-exclude a source this many chapters behind your progress

fields.name: parallelBatch
fields.label: How many providers to scan in parallel at once

fields.name: syncNativeButtons
fields.label: Trigger a scan from seanime's own "Reload sources" (entry page) and "Refresh sources" (library) buttons

fields.name: githubPat
fields.label: GitHub token (PAT with the 'gist' scope) — optional fallback if you prefer not to use the in-app 'Connect GitHub' browser login.

fields.name: autoSync
fields.label: Auto-sync: periodically pull + merge + push your MSU data via the Gist
